description: Johnny Austin Thompson is the sole Democratic candidate selected to represent district 2. Born and raised in Pensacola, Johnny understands the challenges facing Northwest Florida because he’s lived them. From skyrocketing insurance rates to failing healthcare access to classrooms stretched thin, families across the district are being left behind. Johnny is running to change that. Contact us…
title: Johnny Austin Thompson for Florida House – Johnny Austin Thompson is proud to be the unified Democratic candidate for Florida House District 2. A product of our local schools and a lifelong advocate for community health and opportunity, Johnny is running to ensure every family has access to quality healthcare, safe neighborhoods, good jobs, and a clean Gulf Coast. He brings a fresh vision rooted in accountability, service, and a belief that Escambia County deserves a representative working for all of us—not just the well-connected.
